title: Proposal for Cohort Smoking Ban in Singapore
what_it_is: Proposal for Cohort Smoking Ban in Singapore

sections.label: New Zealand tobacco cohort ban
sections.summary: New Zealand has introduced legislation for a tobacco cohort ban limited to retail sale, with a longer-term goal of denormalising smoking.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: New Zealand has introduced legislation to implement a tobacco cohort ban.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: It has, however, not banned vaping, unlike Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We will study further on whether New Zealand’s implementation approach is feasible in Singapore, as the implementation of the ban in New Zealand will be limited to retail sale to affected cohorts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Therefore, affected cohorts will still be able to smoke cigarettes that are supplied by their peers or others who are not from the affected cohorts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The tobacco-free generation policy in New Zealand will have a longer-term goal of denormalising smoking rather than completely curbing access to tobacco products in the short term.

sections.label: Other countries announcing intent
sections.summary: Denmark, Malaysia and the UK have announced intent to introduce and implement this policy, but no details on legislation or timeline exist.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Besides New Zealand, I believe Denmark, Malaysia and the UK have also announced their intent to introduce and implement this policy, but there are no details yet on these countries' legislation or timeline for implementation.

sections.label: Laws penalising older suppliers
sections.summary: A completely effective ban requires laws to penalise older persons not subject to the ban who abet or supply the products.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For a ban to be completely effective at curbing access to tobacco products for the affected cohorts, we need to introduce laws to penalise older persons who are not subject to the ban but they may abetting or supplying the products.

sections.label: Review and vaping campaign
sections.summary: These matters are being reviewed, and a campaign against vaping was announced for the first part of this year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: These are things that are currently being reviewed, as we speak.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have already announced that there is going to be a campaign against vaping, coming up in the first part of this year.
